name: wrench-baseline
title: Wrench opinionated baseline
description: The basics wrench believes every box owes itself. Small, loud, and honest.

rules.title: unattended-upgrades installed
rules.rationale: Security patches that wait for a human do not happen.

rules.title: a firewall package is present (ufw)
rules.rationale: A host firewall is the cheapest blast-radius reducer.

rules.title: sshd is key-only
rules.rationale: Passwords on an internet-facing sshd are a time bomb.

rules.title: no empty password hashes
rules.rationale: Passwordless login is not a configuration, it is an incident.

rules.title: root is the only UID-0 account
full ASLR enabled
rules.rationale: Free exploit mitigation; never turn it off.

rules.title: no telnet server
rules.rationale: Plaintext shells are an incident with a service file.

rules.title: sshd_config not world-writable
rules.rationale: Anyone who can edit sshd_config owns the next restart.

rules.title: /tmp mounted nosuid
rules.rationale: No privilege elevation from scratch space.

rules.title: martian packets logged
rules.rationale: Spoofed traffic should leave a trace.

rules.title: cron running
rules.rationale: The box's own housekeeping depends on it.
